decisions.quote:
We expected to replicate Carney et al.’s (2010) results when
participants looked directly ahead, such that high-power (vs.
low power) posers report feeling more powerful and take the
gambling risk more often; we also expected these participants
to demonstrate dominance in the ultimatum game (consistent

decisions.reason: Garrison, Tang, and Schmeichel (2016) empirically retest Tang and Schmeichel's (2015) finding that manipulated direct (vs. averted) eye gaze increases dominant behavior in a hypothetical $40 ultimatum game (offering less money, requiring higher minimum acceptable offers, composite dominance score, and rejecting a low $5 offer). The authors administer the exact ultimatum game prompt and measures from Tang and Schmeichel (2015) following a direct vs. averted eye-gaze manipulation and explicitly compare their results to Tang and Schmeichel (2015) in Results and Discussion (confirming increased rejection of the $5 offer under direct gaze, while finding no effect on the amounts offered or accepted or the composite score). The only shipped row (input_row_index 1046) is Carney, Cuddy, and Yap (2010, 10.1177/0956797610383437), a distinct study on body posture, hormones, risk taking, and feelings of power; report equivalence does not apply. No DOI is printed for Tang and Schmeichel (2015) in the source reference list, and no prior adjudication/state files exist at the listed paths.

decisions.quote: Aims: This study investigated if formerly observed effects of gibberellic acid 14x – 30x on growth of Lemna gibba were reproducible. Methododology: Duckweed was grown in dilutions of gibberellic acid (14x–30x) as well as once succussed (c1) and unsuccussed (c0) water control. Area-related growth rate for day 0–7 was determined by a computerised image analysis system. Three series including five independent blinded and randomised experiments each were carried out in the same way as in the original study. Only time and conductor of experiments were modified.
decisions.reason: The supplied source text consists solely of a conference abstract without in-text citations or a reference list. Although it states that three series of five experiments were carried out in the same way as 'the original study' / 'the former study' on gibberellic acid 14x–30x and growth of Lemna gibba L., the unresolved question is the explicit bibliographic identity of that former study and whether it is already represented by shipped row 965 (Scherr, Simon, Spranger, & Baumgartner, 2009, 10.1016/j.ctim.2008.10.004) or is a distinct unshipped report. No prior adjudication/state files exist at the listed paths.

decisions.quote: The single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) rs1126671 located in exon 7 of the ADH4 gene was associated with an increased risk for CH in two Italian studies, whereas rs1800759 located in the promoter region of ADH4 could only be associated with CH in the smaller case–control study. 17
decisions.reason: Fourier et al. (2016) empirically retest the genetic association of two ADH4 SNPs (rs1126671 and rs1800759) with cluster headache (CH) in a Swedish case–control cohort (390 cases, 389 controls). While both cited Italian studies reported an association for rs1126671, only reference 17—Zarrilli et al. (2015, 10.1097/AJP.0000000000000075), the smaller Italian case–control study (54 CH patients)—found an association between rs1800759 and CH, and the authors explicitly test both SNPs and compare their genotype and allele frequencies to both Italian studies in the Results and Discussion. The only shipped row (input_row_index 2498) is Rainero et al. (2010, 10.1111/j.1526-4610.2009.01569.x, Reference 16), an independent earlier study of 110 CH patients by a different Italian research group; report equivalence does not apply.
